name: M8
title: Beta-distributed omega with an additional positively selected category

args.name: submodel
args.description: Codon model as a function of omega

args.name: n
args.description: Number of categories approximating the Beta distribution

args.name: mu
args.description: The mean of the Beta distribution

args.name: v
args.description: The normalized Beta variance Var(omega)/(mu*(1-mu)); 0 < v < 1

args.name: posP
args.description: The fraction of positively selected sites

args.name: posW
args.description: The omega value for positively selected sites

description:
M8 combines an M7 component of weight 1-posP with an additional category of weight posP and omega=posW. The default prior restricts posW to values greater than 1 (positive selection).

The default background uses GTR, MNM, and MutSelAA. Here omega scales nonsynonymous rates after accounting for amino-acid fitnesses. Thus omega=1 retains these fitness effects; neutrality and positive selection are assessed relative to this background.

The Beta component uses Gauss-Jacobi quadrature with generally unequal category weights. There are n+1 categories in total.

citation.title: Codon-Substitution Models for Heterogeneous Selection Pressure at Amino Acid Sites
